---
title: "Permutation Test: Visualization (Lite)"
subtitle: "Null distribution and p-values for Path2D DPS, thresholds 7 & 8"
---

## Overview

Compare observed Path2D DPS against the null distribution from label permutations, compute empirical p-values, and visualize results.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, fs, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Constants

```{r}
#| label: constants

THRESHOLDS <- c(7, 8)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

output_dir <- here("UMAP/lite/output")

# Load permutation and observed DPS for both thresholds
load_threshold <- function(t) {
  list(
    perm_dps = read_rds(here(output_dir, glue("permutation_dps_threshold_{t}.rds"))),
    obs_dps = read_rds(here(output_dir, glue("dps_results_threshold_{t}.rds")))
  )
}

threshold_data <- THRESHOLDS |>
  set_names() |>
  map(load_threshold)

walk(THRESHOLDS, \(t) {
  td <- threshold_data[[as.character(t)]]
  message(glue("Threshold {t}: {nrow(td$perm_dps)} perm rows, {nrow(td$obs_dps)} observed rows"))
})
```

## Compute Empirical P-values

p = (# permutations with DPS >= observed) / N_permutations

```{r}
#| label: compute-pvalues

pvalues <- imap_dfr(threshold_data, \(td, t_chr) {
  t_num <- as.integer(t_chr)

  td$obs_dps |>
    select(dimx, dimy, path2d_dps) |>
    rename(observed = path2d_dps) |>
    left_join(
      td$perm_dps |> select(perm_id, dimx, dimy, path2d_dps),
      by = c("dimx", "dimy"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) |>
    summarise(
      observed = first(observed),
      n_perm_gte = sum(path2d_dps >= observed, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_permutations = n(),
      p_value = n_perm_gte / n_permutations,
      perm_mean = mean(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
      perm_sd = sd(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = c(dimx, dimy)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      threshold = t_num,
      dim_pair = glue("{dimx} vs {dimy}")
    )
})

message(glue("P-values computed: {nrow(pvalues)} (dim pairs x thresholds)"))
```

## P-value Summary

```{r}
#| label: pvalue-summary

pvalue_summary <- pvalues |>
  summarise(
    n_pairs = n(),
    n_significant = sum(p_value < 0.05),
    prop_significant = n_significant / n_pairs,
    mean_pvalue = mean(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_pvalue = min(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = threshold
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !c(n_pairs, n_significant, threshold), \(x) round(x, 3)))

pvalue_summary
```

## Null Distribution Histograms

Faceted histograms per dimension pair with observed line and p-value.

```{r}
#| label: null-distribution-histograms
#| output: false

hist_plots <- THRESHOLDS |>
  set_names() |>
  map(\(t) {
    td <- threshold_data[[as.character(t)]]
    # Permutation P values are printed at the resolution of the 1,000 permutations (three
    # decimals), and as the bound "< 0.001" when none reached the observed DPS (R1.5); the P is
    # bold italic, as in the house style (custom_func/p_value_label.R)
    stopifnot(all(pvalues$n_permutations == 1000))
    pval_data <- pvalues |>
      filter(threshold == t) |>
      mutate(label = if_else(
        n_perm_gte == 0,
        'bolditalic(P)~bold("< 0.001")',
        as.character(glue('bolditalic(P)~bold("= {sprintf("%.3f", p_value)}")'))
      ))

    obs_data <- td$obs_dps |>
      mutate(dim_pair = glue("{dimx} vs {dimy}"))

    perm_data <- td$perm_dps |>
      mutate(dim_pair = glue("{dimx} vs {dimy}"))

    ggplot(perm_data, aes(x = path2d_dps)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "gray70", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_vline(
        data = obs_data,
        aes(xintercept = path2d_dps),
        color = "red", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      geom_text(
        data = pval_data,
        aes(label = label),
        x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
        size = 3, color = "red", parse = TRUE,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~dim_pair, scales = "free_x", ncol = 5) +
      labs(
        title = glue("Null Distribution: DPS (Threshold {t})"),
        subtitle = "Red dashed line = observed; gray = permuted null",
        x = "DPS",
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
  })
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-null-distributions
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 10

walk(hist_plots, print)
```

## P-value Heatmap

Dimension pairs (rows) x thresholds (columns).

```{r}
#| label: fig-pvalue-heatmap
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8

plot_pvalue_heatmap <- ggplot(
  pvalues,
  aes(x = factor(threshold), y = dim_pair, fill = p_value)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf("%.3f", p_value),
      color = p_value < 0.05
    ),
    size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "black")) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#b2182b", mid = "#fddbc7", high = "white",
    midpoint = 0.05, limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "p-value"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Empirical P-values: Observed vs Permuted Path2D DPS",
    subtitle = "Red = significant (p < 0.05); white = non-significant",
    x = "Threshold",
    y = "Dimension Pair"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

plot_pvalue_heatmap
```

## Summary Boxplot

Permuted vs observed aggregate DPS.

```{r}
#| label: fig-summary-boxplot
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# Aggregate permuted DPS across dim pairs per permutation
perm_agg <- imap_dfr(threshold_data, \(td, t_chr) {
  td$perm_dps |>
    summarise(
      path2d_dps = mean(path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = perm_id
    ) |>
    mutate(threshold = as.integer(t_chr), source = "Permuted")
})

# Aggregate observed DPS
obs_agg <- imap_dfr(threshold_data, \(td, t_chr) {
  tibble(
    path2d_dps = mean(td$obs_dps$path2d_dps, na.rm = TRUE),
    threshold = as.integer(t_chr),
    source = "Observed"
  )
})

plot_summary_boxplot <- ggplot(
  perm_agg,
  aes(x = factor(threshold), y = path2d_dps)
) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = obs_agg,
    aes(x = factor(threshold), y = path2d_dps),
    color = "red", size = 5, shape = 18
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Permuted Path2D DPS vs Observed",
    subtitle = "Boxplots = permuted null (mean across dim pairs); red diamond = observed",
    x = "Threshold",
    y = "Mean Path2D DPS Across Dim Pairs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_summary_boxplot
```

## Save Plots

```{r}
#| label: save-plots

walk(THRESHOLDS, \(t) {
  fig_dir <- here(glue("UMAP/lite/permutation/output/fig_tbl/threshold_{t}"))
  fs::dir_create(fig_dir)

  ggsave(
    here(fig_dir, "fig_null_distribution_path2d.png"),
    hist_plots[[as.character(t)]], width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300,
    bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
  )
  write_rds(hist_plots[[as.character(t)]], here(fig_dir, "fig_null_distribution_path2d.rds"))
})

# Save heatmap and summary boxplot (shared across thresholds)
fig_dir_shared <- here("UMAP/lite/permutation/output/fig_tbl")
fs::dir_create(fig_dir_shared)

ggsave(
  here(fig_dir_shared, "fig_pvalue_heatmap.png"),
  plot_pvalue_heatmap, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300,
  bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
)
write_rds(plot_pvalue_heatmap, here(fig_dir_shared, "fig_pvalue_heatmap.rds"))

ggsave(
  here(fig_dir_shared, "fig_permutation_summary_boxplot.png"),
  plot_summary_boxplot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300,
  bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
)
write_rds(plot_summary_boxplot, here(fig_dir_shared, "fig_permutation_summary_boxplot.rds"))

message("Saved all permutation visualization plots")
```

## Summary

```{r}
#| label: final-summary

pvalues |>
  summarise(
    n_significant = sum(p_value < 0.05),
    n_total = n(),
    top_pair = dim_pair[which.min(p_value)],
    min_p = min(p_value),
    .by = threshold
  )
```
